summary: Returns the value after checking that it is not an array.
description: `Array.isArray` is the whole test, so an array from another frame counts and an array-like object — `arguments`, a `NodeList`, `{ length: 0 }` — does not.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

params.message: The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted.
params.strict: When `true`, a string counts as empty only if it has no characters at all; by default whitespace is trimmed first.

returns: the same value, with an array excluded from its type.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
requireNonArray("abc"); // => "abc"
requireNonArray({ length: 0 }); // => { length: 0 }
requireNonArray([]); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireNonArray([1, 2, 3]); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
